target.definition: Scan exact one-minute bars T0 through T0+4. Stop at first bar reaching either frozen P0±0.20M threshold. Both touched in that bar => TWO_SIDED_WHIPSAW; exactly one touched => CLEAN_ONE_SIDED. No threshold and missing OHLC prefix are separate, not classifier labels. First-side ordering is unnecessary.
target.missing: Any missing OHLC in required prefix up to first event => MISSING_PATH; complete five-minute prefix with neither => NO_THRESHOLD

first_break_predictors.first_event_minute: Categorical 0/1/2/3/4, known at the event; one-hot categories fixed, drop0 reference
first_break_predictors.opening_event: 1 if first event is current bar opening print at/beyond either threshold, otherwise0. Uses only that opening print; no first-side or later extrema.

omissions.last_completed_5m_range: No separate frozen field; retain existing current_bar_range_vs_prior_6 without expanding library
omissions.exact_elapsed_seconds: Unavailable for all candidates; do not mix tick availability into predictor
omissions.event_previous_close_displacement: Would require first direction for unresolved bars; omitted
omissions.event_vwap_and_volume: No uniformly proven event-time cache; omitted

natural_splits: existing prior percentile band state LOW/HIGH/MISSING
preprocessing: Median imputation fit on fit partition only, with missing indicators learned on fit; keep_empty_features=True; standardisation fitted on fit only. Categorical event-minute one-hot fixed categories0..4 dropping0. No feature selection or interactions.
univariate: Raw numeric values: clean/whipsaw means, standardized mean difference=(mean_whip-mean_clean)/sqrt((var_whip+var_clean)/2), raw-value ROC AUC. No optimized cutoff or orientation. Report fit/assessment/all separately. Natural state counts/rates use existing frozen splits.
assessment_metrics: fixed risk quintiles with observed rates and mean predicted probabilities
month-specific results using same global assessment bucket assignment
quintiles: Rank assessment predictions ascending, deterministic signal_id tie-break, split into five equal-count groups before inspecting assessment labels. Diagnostic buckets only. Bootstrap preserves original score and bucket memberships. Other population percentiles/buckets reference the assessment score distribution and are labelled FIT or ASSESSMENT.

bootstrap.endpoint: highest-quintile minus lowest-quintile whipsaw-rate difference, percentage points

payoff_overlay: Only after model parameters, predictions, target metrics and quintile memberships are saved and hashed, join the existing cached first-break continuation ledger. No outcome refit. Report coverage and missing-order bias per bucket; no threshold selection.
scope: All2060 frozen T0_CAUSAL_NON_MID; no direction prediction, cap/TOP5/hurdle/return/unknown-status filtering, parameter or model-family search. No new data.
decision_guidance: Use chronological assessment ranking breadth and July/August stability; strict monotonicity, AUC, calibration, effect interval and payoff coverage reported without selecting a trading threshold. Existing development exposure remains explicit.
